# Claude Code Docs

## Getting started

- [Quickstart](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/quickstart.md): Welcome to Claude Code!
- [Connect Claude Code to tools via MCP](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp.md): Learn how to connect Claude Code to your tools.
- [Automate actions with hooks](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks-guide.md): Run shell commands automatically.
- [How Claude remembers your project](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/memory.md): CLAUDE.md files and auto memory.
- [Documentation en français](https://code.claude.com/docs/_llms/fr.md)
